source.test: C. every stated combination of co-firing plan policies is what the evaluator does, for 1–12 sets

nouns.stalled: sessions in a row with a missed set

programNouns.stalled: sessions in a row with a missed set

ret: When this is a deload week and your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3: the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 25% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When this is a deload week and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3 and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When this is a deload week and your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3 and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 72.9% of the load, 25% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.
